question: Can ESP32 chip revision v3.1 use EXT0 wake-up together with the ULP coprocessor and touch wake-up during Deep Sleep?

content.text: Question: Can ESP32 chip revision v3.1 use EXT0 wake-up together with the ULP coprocessor and touch wake-up during Deep Sleep?

generation.answer: No, ESP32 chip revision v3.1 cannot use EXT0 wake-up together with the ULP coprocessor and touch wake-up during Deep Sleep. According to Page 3 (document espressif_esp32_refman, page 191), in Deep-sleep mode, only RTC GPIOs (not DIGITAL GPIOs) can work as wakeup source. Therefore, the ULP co-processor and touch sensor functionalities are not available in Deep-sleep mode if RTC_PERIPH is powered up [Page 1].
